description: This file defines a Flutter widget named BoardShortcuts that provides keyboard shortcut functionality (specifically for the Enter and Space keys) to activate a child widget. It is used to enable keyboard-based activation (like pressing Enter or Space) within a Flutter application, likely for accessibility or enhanced user interaction.

classes.name: BoardShortcuts
classes.description: A Flutter widget that enables keyboard activation (Enter/Space) for its child widget by intercepting specific keyboard shortcuts and invoking a callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree that wraps the child with keyboard shortcuts and action handlers to invoke the onActivate callback when Enter or Space is pressed.
